landing.title: HeatShield — ward-level extreme heat early warning for Kolkata
landing.description: Ward-level heat risk, human thermal stress (WBGT) and action thresholds for Kolkata and Delhi NCR, built on keyless open data.

dashboard.title: Kolkata operations dashboard — 141 wards, live heat risk | HeatShield

phone.title: Citizen heat brief — what to do where you are | HeatShield
phone.description: A one-minute local heat brief: current risk band, the protective action to take, and the days ahead.

demo.title: Heat risk demo — synthetic scenarios, no API needed | HeatShield
demo.description: Deterministic labelled scenarios that show how the warning chain behaves, offline and with no credentials.

privacy.title: Privacy — what HeatShield collects | HeatShield
privacy.description: What this deployment collects, what it deliberately does not, and how to have your data removed.

terms.description: Terms of use, the limits of the science, and what HeatShield does not promise.
